parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description: Filters by accelerator type of the instance. Default value: empty, which queries instances of all accelerator types. Valid values:

parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description: Filters by workspace visibility of the instance. Default value: empty, which queries instances of all visibility types. Valid values:

parameters.name: CreateTimeAfter
parameters.description: If specified, only instances created at or after this time are returned.

parameters.name: CreateTimeBefore
parameters.description: If specified, only instances created at or before this time are returned.

parameters.name: CreateUserId
parameters.description: If specified, filters instances by the creator user ID.

parameters.name: GpuType
parameters.description: If specified, filters instances by GPU model.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The image name. If specified, filters instances by the image name used by the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: If specified, filters instances by exact instance ID. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~470439~~). You can specify multiple IDs separated by commas.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The instance name. If specified, instances are searched by name using fuzzy match with case insensitivity. Default value: empty.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: If specified, filters instances by labels. A maximum of four label groups are supported, and multiple label groups are combined using AND conditions.

parameters.name: MaxCpu
parameters.description: The maximum number of CPUs, in units of 0.001 CPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 CPU. If specified, only instances with a CPU count less than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MaxGpu
parameters.description: The maximum number of GPUs, in units of 0.001 GPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 GPU. If specified, only instances with a GPU count less than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MaxGpuMemory
parameters.description: The maximum GPU memory per card in GB. If specified, only instances with GPU memory less than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MaxMemory
parameters.description: The maximum memory size in GB. If specified, only instances with memory less than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MinCpu
parameters.description: The minimum number of CPUs, in units of 0.001 CPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 CPU. If specified, only instances with a CPU count greater than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MinGpu
parameters.description: The minimum number of GPUs, in units of 0.001 GPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 GPU. If specified, only instances with a GPU count greater than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MinGpuMemory
parameters.description: The minimum GPU memory per card in GB. If specified, only instances with GPU memory greater than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: MinMemory
parameters.description: The minimum memory size in GB. If specified, only instances with memory greater than the specified value are returned.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: DESC and ASC. Default value: DESC.

parameters.name: OversoldInfo
parameters.description: The idle resource type actually used by the instance. If specified, filters instances by the idle resource type actually in use. Valid values:

parameters.name: OversoldType
parameters.description: The idle resource type specified by the user. If specified, filters instances by the idle resource type. Valid values:

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paging query of instances. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of instances returned per page in a paging query. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description: Filters by payment type (subscription or pay-as-you-go). Default value: empty, which queries instances of all payment types.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: Filters by resource quota ID. For information about how to obtain the resource quota ID, see [ListQuotas](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-listquotas).

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field used for sorting.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filters by instance status. Default value: empty, which queries instances in all states.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. If specified, filters instances by tags. A maximum of four tag groups are supported, and multiple tag groups are combined using AND conditions.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: Filters by workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
